15242-desert-love.description: A book by The Macaulay Company. with blood-curdling threats, a detachment of British soldiers getting ready to start en route for Suez were urging, coaxing, striving to make that most obstinate of animals, the camel, get to its feet some time before midnight.

48457-borth-lyrics.title: Borth Lyrics
48457-borth-lyrics.creator: Edward Thring, M.A.
48457-borth-lyrics.description: A book by Edward Thring, M.A.. with thy joyous sweep o’er earth and sunlit sea,  O swallow, who, if night were thine, would’st wheel amongst the stars,  Why linger round the eaves? free of all the world hast knit thy soul to clay? And glued thy heart up on the wall, thou swiftest child of day? Claim, glorious wing, thy heritage; break, break thy prison bars,  Nor linger round the eaves.

arxiv-2101-11278.title: "Can I Touch This?": Survey of Virtual Reality Interactions via Haptic Solutions DOI: 10.1145/XXXXXXXXX.XXXXXXXX Conference: 32 e confrence Francophone sur l’Interaction Homme-Machine; April 13–16, 2021; Metz, France IHM ’20’21 : 32 e confrence Francophone sur l’Interaction Homme-Machine, April 13–1
arxiv-2101-11278.creator: Elodie Bouzbib, Gilles Bailly, Sinan Haliyo, Pascal Frey
arxiv-2101-11278.description: Abstract . Haptic feedback has become crucial to enhance the user experiences in Virtual Reality (VR). This justifies the sudden burst of novel haptic solutions proposed these past years in the HCI community. This article is a survey of Virtual Reality interactions, relying on haptic devices.

arxiv-2201-08503.title: A low-frequency, high-amplitude, torsional oscillator for turbulence studies in quantum fluids
arxiv-2201-08503.creator: A. M. Guénault †, P. V. E. McClintock, M. Poole, R. Schanen, V. Tsepelin, D. Zmeev, D. Schmoranzer, W. F. Vinen
arxiv-2201-08503.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by A. M. Guénault †, P. V. E. McClintock, M. Poole, R. Schanen, V. Tsepelin, D. Zmeev, D. Schmoranzer, W. F. Vinen. We describe a new type of torsional oscillator, suitable for studies of quantum fluids at frequencies of ∼ \sim 100 Hz 100\text{\,}\mathrm{H}\mathrm{z} , but capable of reaching high velocities of up to several cm s -1 . This requires the oscillator amplitude to exceed 100 μ ​ m 100\text{\,}\mu\mathrm{m} , which is much too large for a conventional capacitor-driven device.

arxiv-2207-05784.title: Distilled Non-Semantic Speech Embeddings with Binary Neural Networks for Low-Resource Devices
arxiv-2207-05784.creator: Harlin Lee, Aaqib Saeed
arxiv-2207-05784.description: Abstract This work introduces BRILLsson, a novel binary neural network-based representation learning model for a broad range of non-semantic speech tasks. We train the model with knowledge distillation from a large and real-valued TRILLsson model with only a fraction of the dataset used to train TRILLsson.

arxiv-2303-12200.title: Schoen’s conjecture for limits of isoperimetric surfaces
arxiv-2303-12200.creator: Michael Eichmair, Thomas Koerber
arxiv-2303-12200.description: Abstract . Let ( M , g ) (M,g) be an asymptotically flat Riemannian manifold of dimension 3 ≤ n ≤ 7 3\leq n\leq 7 with non-negative scalar curvature. R. Schoen has conjectured that ( M , g ) (M,g) is isometric to Euclidean space if it admits a non-compact area-minimizing hypersurface Σ ⊂ M \Sigma\subset M .

arxiv-2402-09817.title: On a Serrin-type overdetermined problem
arxiv-2402-09817.creator: Celentano A, Nitsch C, Trombetti C
arxiv-2402-09817.description: Abstract In this paper, we prove a Serrin-type result for an elliptic system of equations, overdetermined with both Dirichlet and a generalized Neumann conditions. With this tool, we characterize the critical shapes under volume constraint of some domain functionals. MSC 2020: 35B06; 35J57; 35N25. Keywords: Overdetermined problem; radial symmetry; first eigenvalue; torsional rigidity; domain derivative. E-mail address , A.

arxiv-2411-15218.title: Suspected Undeclared Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Academic Literature
arxiv-2411-15218.creator: Alex Glynn, MA
arxiv-2411-15218.description: Abstract Since generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT became widely available, researchers have used them in the writing process. The consensus of the academic publishing community is that such usage must be declared in the published article.

arxiv-2502-12650.title: Chronus: Understanding and Securing the Cutting-Edge Industry Solutions to DRAM Read Disturbance
arxiv-2502-12650.creator: Oğuzhan Canpolat § † \dagger A. Giray Yağlıkçı § Geraldo F. Oliveira § Ataberk Olgun § Nisa Bostancı § Ismail Emir Yuksel § Haocong Luo § Oğuz Ergin ‡ \ddagger † \dagger Onur Mutlu § § ETH Zürich † \dagger TOBB University of Economics and Technology ‡ \ddagger University of Sharjah
arxiv-2502-12650.description: Abstract Read disturbance in modern DRAM is an important robustness (security, safety, and reliability) problem, where repeatedly accessing (hammering) a row of DRAM cells (DRAM row) induces bitflips in other physically nearby DRAM rows. Shrinking technology node size exacerbates DRAM read disturbance over generations.

pmc-10855281.title: A Case Report of Anesthesia-induced Diffuse Alveolar Hemorrhage Presenting to the Emergency Department
pmc-10855281.creator: Daniel Yiu, Christopher Stephens, Jacquelyn McCullough, Lesley Osborn
pmc-10855281.description: IntroductionThe inhaled anesthetic sevoflurane is an uncommon etiology of diffuse alveolar hemorrhage (DAH). As DAH typically presents in the inpatient, postoperative setting, it has been infrequently reported in the anesthesiology literature and, to our knowledge, has not been reported in the emergency medicine literature to date.

pmc-11314291.title: Advancing Metallic Lithium Anodes: A Review of Interface Design, Electrolyte Innovation, and Performance Enhancement Strategies
pmc-11314291.creator: Junwei Shi, Kailin Jiang, Yameng Fan, Lingfei Zhao, Zhenxiang Cheng, Peng Yu, Jian Peng, Min Wan
pmc-11314291.description: Lithium (Li) metal is one of the most promising anode materials for next-generation, high-energy, Li-based batteries due to its exceptionally high specific capacity and low reduction potential. Nonetheless, intrinsic challenges such as detrimental interfacial reactions, significant volume expansion, and dendritic growth present considerable obstacles to its practical application.

pmc-11430559.title: Metabolic Reprogramming in Glioblastoma Multiforme: A Review of Pathways and Therapeutic Targets
pmc-11430559.creator: Ashley Irin Cortes Ballen, Maryam Amosu, Surya Ravinder, Joey Chan, Emre Derin, Hasan Slika, Betty Tyler, Shan Ping Yu
pmc-11430559.description: Glioblastoma (GBM) is an aggressive and highly malignant primary brain tumor characterized by rapid growth and a poor prognosis for patients. Despite advancements in treatment, the median survival time for GBM patients remains low. One of the crucial challenges in understanding and treating GBMs involves its remarkable cellular heterogeneity and adaptability.

pmc-11578479.title: Time-Series analysis of short-term exposure to air pollutants and daily hospital admissions for stroke in Tabriz, Iran
pmc-11578479.creator: Shahryar Razzaghi, Saeid Mousavi, Mehran Jaberinezhad, Ali Farshbaf Khalili, Seyed Mahdi Banan Khojasteh, Worradorn Phairuang, Worradorn Phairuang, Worradorn Phairuang
pmc-11578479.description: BackgroundAir pollution is considered one of the risk factors for stroke prevalence in the long term and incidence in the short term. Tabriz is one of the most important industrial cities in Iran. Hence, air pollution has always been one of the main concerns in environmental health in the region.

pmc-11859486.title: Logistic regression model for the prediction of asthenia development in schizophrenia based on inflammatory blood markers
pmc-11859486.creator: S A Zozulya, A N Simonov, T P Klyushnik
pmc-11859486.description: IntroductionAccording to a number of authors, inflammation is involved in the development of asthenic syndrome in different diseases. The results of our own studies indicate that the main feature of the spectrum of inflammatory markers in patients with asthenic syndrome in schizophrenia is low enzymatic activity of leukocyte elastase against the background of high levels of other inflammatory markers.

pmc-13652991.title: Liver regeneration governed by zonated PIEZO1 mechanotransduction
pmc-13652991.creator: Lin Xie, Chen Zhang, Yonglong Wei, Wenxiu Ning
pmc-13652991.description: Mechanical forces are recognized as regulators of organ development, homeostasis, and regeneration, yet how physical cues are sensed in a region-specific manner within the liver remains unclear. In a Science article, Zhang and colleagues identify DPP4-positive zone 2 hepatocytes as a mechanosensory population, demonstrating that mechanical stress triggers the regenerative response through PIEZO1-mediated mechanotransduction.
